My Shop / Ms Vladimirova,

We regret your disappointment that we were unable to register you as you live outside the practice catchment area. 

GP practices operate within defined geographical boundaries, similar to school catchment areas. This approach is standard NHS practice.

Due to the limited size of our premises and the popularity of our services, we are only able to register patients who live within our catchment area so that we can prioritise care for local residents.

Our registration process is applied consistently to all applicants. The policy, including in-area postcodes, is clearly outlined on our registration page: https://www.willesdengreensurgery.nhs.uk/new-
patients
